mapper.sql: id, chapter_id, source_variant_id, variant_type, language_code, content, content_hash, source_content_hash, translation_status, translation_provider, translation_model, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO chapter_content_variants (chapter_id, source_variant_id, variant_type, language_code, content, content_hash, source_content_hash, translation_status, translation_provider, translation_model, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{sourceVariantId}, #{type}, #{languageCode}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{sourceContentHash}, #{translationStatus}, #{translationProvider}, #{translationModel}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id

SELECT v.* FROM chapter_content_variants v JOIN chapters c ON c.id = v.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND c.id = #{chapterId} AND v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.* FROM chapter_content_variants v JOIN chapters c ON c.id = v.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND c.id = #{chapterId} AND v.id = #{variantId}

SELECT v.* FROM chapter_content_variants v JOIN chapters c ON c.id = v.chapter_id WHERE v.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND v.variant_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND v.content_hash = c.source_hash ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.* FROM chapter_content_variants v JOIN chapters c ON c.id = v.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND c.id = #{chapterId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_content_variants SET translation_status = 'STALE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND variant_type = 'TRANSLATION' AND source_variant_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{currentSourceVariantId} AND translation_status NOT IN ('STALE', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE chapter_content_variants SET translation_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{variantId}
